card.line: Bozez was a sharp cliff on one side of a pass near Michmash, where Jonathan set out to attack a Philistine outpost trusting the LORD.

moments.title: Cliff beside Jonathan's pass
moments.text: Jonathan planned to cross a pass to reach the Philistine outpost. Bozez was the cliff on one side, and Seneh was the cliff on the other. Bozez stood to the north toward Michmash.

moments.title: Jonathan trusts the LORD
moments.text: Jonathan told his armor-bearer that nothing can hinder the LORD from saving, whether by many or by few. He set a sign: if the Philistines said, "Come on up," it would show the LORD had given them into their hands.
